text: Good evening. I am minding my granddaughter overnight, she is 2 years old. She has a temperature of 38.6 and I'm quite frightened as I've not had to deal with this on my own before. She says her throat hurts and points to it, but she is still drinking her milk and water. Her breathing is normal, I've been watching her closely and it's steady and quiet. I don't know whether I ought to be ringing her parents or taking her somewhere. Please tell me what to do.
